messages:
maria (Partner Lead): Quick sync — we need to finalize the adapter signal contract with GateFlow and the LangChain runner for marketplace onramp. Legal + SI checklist? ETA for cert and docs. tl;dr: SSO, token relay, telemetry, pricing metadata.
ajay (Eng): We hacked a PoC yesterday. Adapter uses signal header X-GF-Signal v1, passes user_id, session_id, signed by HMAC. Works with our gateway. Pushed gist: https://gist.github.com/abc123
claire (PM): Marketplace requires: SAML + OIDC support, signed manifest, CLI install script, perf SLOs (p95 < 300ms ideally), and security review. Also listing asset checklist.
ryan (Solutions): SI onboarding needs runbook for customer mapping & billing flow. Who owns token flow docs? @maria
sophie (Legal): Need standard MSA addendum for data handling + no-decompilation clause. I'll draft addendum by Thu EOD. Also flagging export control for certain quantized models.
maria (Partner Lead): Thanks @sophie. For tech checklist, can we create a single smoke test harness? @ajay can you add a `make smoke` target in the adapter repo that runs: `./test/smoke --manifest=./manifest.yaml`?
ajay (Eng): Yep. I'll add and wire to CI. Expected PR today. Also adding `--signal-version=1` flag. Example snippet:
```bash
# smoke run
./test/smoke --manifest=manifest.yaml --endpoint https://gf.redwood.dev --auth-token $GF_TOKEN
```
ryan (Solutions): :thumbsup: I'll own the SI runbook doc. Can we set a soft launch for next Tue? Need legal signoff + marketplace listing asset pack.
claire (PM): Market assets: 1pager, screenshots, 2m integration video, quickstart repo. Who can record demo? @ajay?
ajay (Eng): I can record. Prefer Wed morning.
maria (Partner Lead): Action items:
- @sophie draft addendum by Thu
- @ajay PR with smoke target + demo Wed
- @claire marketing assets by Fri
- @ryan SI runbook draft Mon
Quick checkpoint Mon 09:30 PT. Anyone blocked?
sophie (Legal): None. Also request to include `data_retention: 30` days default in manifest.
ajay (Eng): Added to backlog. Will include example manifest snippet in PR:
```yaml
signal:
  version: 1
  retention_days: 30
```
deploy-bot: CI: adapter-main #234 — smoke target job passed ✅
